newsitem.title: BELGIUM: AXA BELGIUM SHARES TO RESUME TRADE NOV 14.
newsitem.headline: AXA BELGIUM SHARES TO RESUME TRADE NOV 14.

text.p: Insurance group Axa said on Wednesday trade in shares in Axa Belgium would resume on Thursday, two days after the shares were suspended following the announcement by the French group of plans to merge with fellow French insurer UAP .
AXA said that, despite its own merger plans, it would maintain its public offer for shares in AXA Belgium which opened on November 4 and runs to November 26.
AXA is offering AXA Belgium investors three of its own shares for every two held in AXA Belgium.

The French group already controls all but 5.23 percent of the Belgian unit and aims, following the bid, to use a new Belgian law to squeeze out the remaining minority shareholders and delist the unit.
AXA Belgium was the only AXA unit to have a listing outside the group's two main quotations in Paris and New York.
